summary:
SPHERE TRACK is an interactive astronomical investigation platform built using real observations from NASA's SPHEREx space telescope. It enables users to explore the changing infrared sky by searching astronomical sources, examining repeated observations, comparing images across time, and investigating unusual signals.

The platform transforms complex archive data into an accessible visual experience through an interactive sky map, image viewer, pixel inspector, difference imaging, histogram analysis, Gaia source overlays, and pipeline quality assessment tools.

By combining scientific data processing with an intuitive web interface, SPHERE TRACK helps users identify changes, investigate potential transient events, and better understand the quality and limitations of infrared observations. It makes real astronomical archive data easier to explore, interpret, and investigate.
details:
SPHERE TRACK is a web-based astronomical investigation platform designed to make real SPHEREx infrared observations easier to explore and analyze.

The platform retrieves observations from the NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA), processes astronomical FITS data, and presents the results through an interactive interface.

Its major features include:

• Interactive Sky Map: Explore observation coverage and locate available astronomical observations.

• Observation Explorer: Search for astronomical targets and examine available observations across different dates, detectors, and wavelengths.

• Image Viewer: Visualize infrared observations with adjustable display scaling and image controls.

• Difference Imaging: Compare observations to identify changes and unusual signals across time.

• Pixel Inspector: Examine individual pixel values and surrounding image regions.

• Histogram Analysis: Understand image intensity distributions.

• Gaia Overlay: Compare observed sources with astronomical catalog information.

• Pipeline QA: Inspect data quality flags and relevant FITS metadata.

• Investigation Tools: Examine unusual features across repeated observations and detectors.

The frontend is developed using React, TypeScript, and Vite. The backend uses Python, FastAPI, Astropy, PyVO, NumPy, and Reproject for archive access and astronomical image processing.

SPHERE TRACK's central idea is to turn repeated observations into an investigative experience rather than simply displaying static astronomical images. It combines scientific data, image analysis, and accessible visualization to help users investigate how the infrared sky changes over time.
